references.text: Continuation of the instruction about casting lots to distribute the land among the larger and smaller tribes.
Reiterates the principle that the land is to be distributed by lot according to families.
Moses commands that the land be distributed by lot to the nine and a half tribes.
The fulfillment of the casting of lots to divide the inheritance in the land of Canaan.
Joshua cast lots for the tribes at Shiloh before the Lord.
Summary of how the land was divided by lot by Eleazar, Joshua, and the heads of families.
The lot is cast into the lap, but the decision comes from the Lord—the principle behind casting lots.
Poetic reference to how God distributed the territories as an inheritance to the tribes of Israel.
Paul refers to how God gave the land of Canaan as an inheritance to the people of Israel.
